data.one_liner: Animates its child widget to a new position automatically when its position changes requiring no calculation.
data.what_it_does: AnimatedTo tracks its child widget using a GlobalKey and automatically animates the child to its new position whenever a rebuild or layout update shifts it. It supports both curve-based animations and spring physics simulations, alongside features like delayed start and coordinate boundaries for gesture handling.
use_when: You want to animate a widget smoothly to a new position when reordered or repositioned via state changes.
You need spring physics or curve-based positional animations without manually calculating delta offsets.
You want to create staggered wave-like layout animations easily using the delay parameter.
avoid_when: You need animations across Sliver-related widgets like ListView where the animation happens across slivers.
You need general non-positional implicit animations or Lottie/Rive animations.
strengths: Requires zero position calculation from the developer.
Supports both curve durations and natural physical spring simulations.
Provides AnimatedToBoundary to correctly handle hit testing and coordinate systems during movement.
weaknesses: Does not work across Sliver-related widgets when the animation happens across slivers.
Requires a GlobalKey to keep the RenderObject alive across depth or position changes.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose flutter_animate if you prefer a comprehensive chained animation extension library for fading, scaling, and moving widgets.

data.minimal_example:
AnimatedTo.curve(
  globalKey: _globalKey,
  child: Container(
    width: 60,
    height: 60,
    color: Colors.blue,
  ),
)
